title: Polynomial-time membership of the verifier
statement: Let $L$ be a language of binary words, and let $a,c$ be natural numbers and $M$ a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet. If $M$ decides $L$ within time $n\mapsto a\cdot 2^{n^c}$, then the padding verifier for $L$ at degree $c$ belongs to $\mathrm{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the binary alphabet
$M$ is a finite binary-alphabet Turing machine
replaced:
If some finite machine decides a language $L$ over the binary alphabet within
time $a \cdot 2^{n^c}$, then the padding verifier of $L$ at degree $c$ belongs
to $\mathrm{P}$.
